lastStand.text: Grimbeak regains 10 HP per hero and rolls d10s instead of d6s.

actions.text: Command all of your spiderling minions to move 6 then attack.

bloodied.name: Avenge Your Queen, My Brood!

lastStand.text: Aranya regains 12 HP per hero and uses Hatch Brood after each of her turns.

actions.text: (Range 8) 2d12+6. Double damage against those behind Cover. (1/round) You may swap places with them.

name: Ul'vek, Psionic Despot

actionsIntro: After each hero's turn, choose one (rec. alternate):

actions.text: Your rolls are disadvantaged. Ul'vek spends your first action on each of your turns: moving, making a weapon attack, or casting a cantrip. Damage ends.

actions.name: Consume
actions.text: (Dominated creature) DC 15 DEX save or 6d12 and Grappled (escape DC 15), half on save. Cannot be Defended or Interposed against.

actions.name: Control
actions.text: Teleport 8. (Reach 8) DC 15 STR save, force an enemy to spend one Action to move, make a weapon attack, or cast a cantrip. On save, they move half as far or attack with disadvantage.

lastStand.name: DOMINATION!
lastStand.text: Ul'vek regains 30 HP per hero, and every hero makes a DC 15 WIL save or becomes Dominated. Dominated no longer ends on taking damage.

actions.text: 2d6+10. Permanently Dazed (Can stack, healing ends; 3 stacks: Petrified).

actions.text: 2d6+10 psychic damage & TERRIFIED: Frightened, and your screams give allies within Reach 6 disadvantage on rolls. Ends when Dravok's plans are FLAWED.

actions.text: 2d6, move target that many spaces. Forced movement deals +5 damage instead of rolling additional dice.

actions.name: 5. Charm Ray
actions.text: Spend 3 Actions for an enemy (you cannot spend any limited resources, they regain any spent actions afterward).

bloodied.name: To Dust!
